summary: HEY CLI là công cụ dòng lệnh và framework cho kỹ năng AI agent, tập trung vào automation và orchestration qua terminal.
usecases: Rapid prototyping of CLI-based AI agents with extensible skill plugins
Automation of terminal tasks through AI-driven intent-to-command execution
Integration into developer workflows for AI-assisted command generation
ideas: Build a natural-language interface that translates user intent to precise CLI commands
Create a reusable skill marketplace for AI agents across multiple projects
Deploy as a lightweight agent orchestrator in CI/CD pipelines for automated testing
